title: The recipe creates the file the target names
objective: Make the hello target write its two lines into a file called hello, so that a second make finds nothing to do.
hint: A target and a file with the same name are tied together. Redirect the first command into hello and append the second one to the same file.

steps.description: both commands of the recipe run on the first make
steps.stdout:
echo "Hello, World" > hello
echo "This line will print if the file hello does not exist." >> hello

Hello, World
This line will print if the file hello does not exist.

steps.description: the target now exists as a file, so make stops

lesson.goal: 让 recipe 创建它声明的目标文件。
lesson.prediction: 如果 recipe 创建 hello，第二次 make 会发生什么？
hints: 目标是否最新取决于同名文件是否存在。
把两行文本写入 hello，而不是只打印到终端。
可以用 echo 和 >、>> 组合写文件。
lesson.explanation: recipe 的副作用必须和目标名一致，否则 make 每次都只能再次尝试。
